Allow clients to ask which physical drive holds a given item.
Disabling this turns the tooltip section and the highlight off for everyone.
ae2itemlocator.config.server.cellsPerTic:
How many storage cells are inspected per server tick while an index is being built.
Lower = smoother, but the first lookup takes longer.
ae2itemlocator.config.server.cacheSecond:
Upper bound on how long a built index may be used before it is rebuilt.
Changes are detected automatically, so this is only a safety net. 0 disables the limit.
Maximum number of drive entries appended to an item tooltip.
ae2itemlocator.config.client.beam.toolti: Draw a vertical light column above every highlighted drive.
ae2itemlocator.config.client.highlightSe:
Automatically clear a locked highlight after this many seconds.
0 keeps it until you press the key again.
ae2itemlocator.config.client.colors.unif: Use a single color for the beam, the drive highlight and the slot highlight.

ae2itemlocator.config.client.colors.slot: Color of the slot outline when 'unified' is disabled.
